designs.title: Demon player
notes: Oryx-style head: spiked cowl blades over the shoulders, a sharpened V jaw, a flat mouthless face and a band of violet eyes.
Robe, cloak, forearm brambles and thorns; bare hands and feet.
Wings fold at the elbow: tucked on the ground, half-open in a jump, spread in flight. Flies without an elytra.

designs.title: Imp Impaler and Imp Firecaster
notes: Imps are one demon species, not the whole faction. They fill only the spearman and archer roles.
Small (0.7x), winged, scorpion-tailed, digitigrade.
Impaler: studded harness and bone spikes. Firecaster: rune mantle, ember orb, fire bolts.

designs.title: Workers: farmers, builders, guards
notes: Plain humanoid working folk in the race's colors: straw hats, knit caps or hoods, smocks, aprons, work caps and kettle helms.
No horns, antennae, wings, spikes or crests.

designs.title: The Hive's look
notes: Sculk-dark: deep teal chitin with glowing cyan veins and green-cyan eyes, like the Warden and the deep dark.
The Swarm (enemy Hive faction): black chitin with acid-green veins.
A cave race: stronger below Y=40 and weaker in sunlight; Swarm raids tunnel up near their target; new Hive players start underground.

designs.title: Lancer-Drone (Hive spearman)
notes: Lean four-armed ant warrior about player height, on bent-back legs.
Upper arms hold a long polearm with a blade at each end; a lower hand holds a three-pointed throwing blade.
Narrow ant head, big glowing compound eyes, small mandibles, long banded antennae. Ragged shoulder wrap and grass skirt.

designs.title: Deepmaw (Hive war beast)
notes: A lobster centaur, about player height and two and a half blocks long.
Lower body: a long carapace on eight crawling legs, with a finned glowing crest, a segmented tail and a tail fan.
An upright plated torso rises from the front, with thick claw arms held out to the sides that snap in a fight.
Head after the reference: a tall spiked crown with two horns, a heavy brow over a row of glowing eyes, a jutting snout, broad bone tusk-blades and thin fangs.
Summoned at the altar; up to 10 per commander, a limit meant to grow with base level.

designs.title: Bone Stalker (Demon war beast)
notes: Gaunt, bone-white and skeletal, prowling on all fours, with blood-red barbs, talons and spines.
Thin insect-like wings with torn pale membrane, and a long spined tail ending in a scorpion stinger.
Works like the Deepmaw: a rare altar unit. Not built yet.
